subject: Next steps & pilot kickoff for Northbridge Analytics - alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed pilot outline

Hi Lena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned and can lock next steps. Main points we heard: 

- Pain & business impact:
  - NLU pipeline misclassifies or drops entities ~18% of the time; this costs ~5–8 hours/week of manual triage across the ops team.
  - Production latency spikes during peak queries; current p95 ~800ms which hurts interactive flows.
  - Cost is becoming a gating factor for broader rollout — team needs predictable unit economics.

- Goals for a successful pilot (we suggested, please confirm):
  - Improve entity extraction F1 by >=10 points on the provided eval set.
  - Reduce p95 generation latency to <=250ms on the target slice.
  - Demonstrate throughput that supports 10k/day queries with an acceptable cost model.

- Data & access notes:
  - You mentioned a 10k example dataset we can use for prompt/eval tuning.
  - We’ll need a sample of the production traffic (redacted) and an S3 link or secure upload for the seed dataset.

- Proposed pilot mechanics (draft):
  - Duration: 3 weeks hands-on evaluation + 1 week buffer for integration/hand-off.
  - Success metrics: F1 on entity set, latency p95, token cost per inference.
  - Deliverables: prompt set + eval harness, weekly checkpoints, runbook for observation & cost breakdown.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm pilot duration and owners on your side.
2) Share the sample dataset and a point of contact for procurement.
3) Pick a kickoff date; we have capacity starting the week of Mar 23.

Attached: nb_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (draft scope & checklist) — includes initial success gates and access checklist.

If that all tracks, I’ll pull in our operations lead (Karthik) and finalize the kickoff plan with dates and access steps.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: nb_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@northbridge.ai>, Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-03-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed pilot outline

Thanks Soojin — this is a great summary and accurately captures our problems and goals. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot length: we’d prefer 4 weeks (3 active + 1 for validation and internal review) rather than 3+1 buffer. Gives our product folks time to validate results against downstream integrations.
- Owners:
  - Product lead: Daniel Park (daniel.park@northbridge.ai) — primary owner for success criteria.
  - Data/ops lead: Procurement looped in for contract / PO coordination; they’re cc’d.
- Data: we can share an S3 read link to a redacted dataset (approx 8k rows) by Fri 3/19.
- Security/compliance asks: please send SOC 2 (Type II) summary and data handling notes — procurement will require that before signing off on the PO.

We’re comfortable with your proposed success metrics; confirm the latency measurement methodology (end-to-end vs your service-only p95). Also we can kick off the week of Mar 23 — Tue 3/24 would work for Daniel.

I’ll get procurement to flag the PO cadence; they typically need the pilot statement of work attached.

Best,
Lena
Director of Product, Northbridge Analytics
lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai

[Attachment: internal_proj_brief.pdf (pdf) — shared for internal use]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed pilot outline

Thanks for the recap — couple of internal notes before we finalize: 
- If they want 4 weeks, we should plan our Ops cadence for a full 4-week sprint. I’ll reserve a dedicated slot on our Dedicated pool for the likely peak (so we don’t get preempted).
- We should prepare a short SOC2 summary + a one-page data residency note for Procurement. Marissa, can you pull the SOC2 summary and the redwood-data-residency.pdf?
- Recommend we list both end-to-end and service-only latency in the kickoff doc; set expectations around network variability.

Karthik

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@northbridge.ai>, Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff — Northbridge Analytics — scope, owners, timeline, access steps (final)

Hi all — per Lena’s note and our internal alignment, here is the finalized kickoff plan for the pilot. Please review and flag any changes by EOD Mon 3/16 so we can lock resources and calendar invites.

1) Scope (what we will do):
  - Run the Redwood evaluation harness on Northbridge’s redacted dataset.
  - Deliver: calibrated prompt set, entity extraction eval (F1/P/R), latency profiles (service-only and end-to-end sampling), and a cost analysis report.
  - Integration: lightweight API adapter for a staging endpoint for your product team to call.

2) Success metrics (primary & secondary):
  - Primary: +10 points F1 on entity extraction vs baseline on the shared eval set.
  - Secondary: service-only p95 <=250ms (measured from our inference layer); end-to-end p95 target <=350ms (measurement will include network and client SDK).
  - Cost target: preliminary target <= $0.015 per inference (subject to model selection & batching).

3) Owners & contacts:
  - Northbridge: Daniel Park (product, primary), Procurement (contracts/PO).
  - Redwood: Soojin Lee (SE lead, day-to-day), Karthik Iyer (Ops/hosting), Marissa Cole (eval & prompt engineering).

4) Timeline (week-by-week):
  - Week 0 (Prep, by 3/23): contracts/PO, SOC2 summary, access granted to S3 sample.
  - Week 1 (3/24–3/30): data onboarding, baseline eval, prompt tuning starts.
  - Week 2 (3/31–4/6): iterative prompt/eval cycles, latency tuning, caching config.
  - Week 3 (4/7–4/13): integration verification, final eval, runbook delivery.
  - Week 4 (4/14–4/20): internal validation, hand-off and decision checkpoint.

5) Access/setup steps (actions we need from Northbridge):
  - Provide S3 read link with sample data + schema file.
  - Create a short-lived API credential or allow our ingestion service to fetch samples over SFTP.
  - Add redwood-kickoff@northbridge.ai Slack channel or give us a point of contact for rapid triage during Week 1.

6) Attachments & links: 
  - Final scope & checklist: nb_pilot_scope_final.pdf
  - Mutual action plan (for signatures): mutual_action_plan_nb.docx
  - HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-12458
  - Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NBpilotShared

If that looks good, I’ll:
- Send the kickoff calendar invite for Tue 3/24 10:00am PT.
- Share the SOC2 Type II summary and a one-pager on data residency for Procurement.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: nb_pilot_scope_final.pdf, mutual_action_plan_nb.docx]
